data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a total prior year release of $3.3 million USD, comprising a $2.7 million profit on the 2015 and prior years of account and a $0.6 million profit on the 2016 year of account. This favorable development was influenced by various factors, including the management of exposure to the Ghanaian Jubilee oil field loss in 2016. Prior period restatements for 2016 included a $1.0 million overstatement in energy construction claim liabilities (a release), a $0.6 million understatement of profit commission payable on aviation contracts (a strengthening), and a $0.5 million understatement of gross written premium (a release).
raw_causal_phrases: profits of $2.7 million and $0.6 million on the 2015 and prior and 2016 years of account respectively
This result for Energy includes exposure on the Ghanaian Jubilee oil field loss, the largest man-made loss for 2016

management identified a calculation error in the prior year estimate of the energy construction claim liabilities at 31 December 2016. The impact of this was a $1.0 million overstatement in claims outstanding provision

management discovered that the Syndicate had not fully accrued for profit commission payable on its aviation consortium contracts for the year ended 31 December 2016. As a consequence, net operating expenses and accrued expenses (within accruals and deferred income) were understated by $0.6 million in the 2016 calendar year result.
An adjustment was also required as a result of an input error to correct a $0.5 million understatement of gross written premium and debtors arising out of direct insurance operations in 2016.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is derived from the breakdown of the calendar year result by year of account, which is a net profit figure for prior years. The claims development triangle shows loss ratios, not absolute claims, and could not be used to calculate prior year development without gross premiums written per underwriting year.
